references.title: Your Europe: Unfair pricing — Easy comparison, price per unit
references.scope: Official EU consumer explanation of comparable unit prices by kilogram/litre and package-size comparisons; no retailer compliance claim.

inputs.assumption: Quoted price applies to the displayed 250 g pack; not verified by receipt or shelf label.

visuals.examples: One conditional rate expressed at different quantities; no competing market offers or claimed purchases.

meaningEvidence: Original local audio and complete transcript reviewed: short humorous reaction to mini bananas, stated €5.50 price and Milan location. The opening joke is not used as origin evidence.
Original poster visually inspected: hand holding a small banana above a clear pack; BANANITO and 250g label visible.

Earlier visual-only evidence correctly recorded that price scope could not be established from label adjacency; recovered audio confirms the amount/location but supplies no receipt or explicit pack-price breakdown.
limitations: €5.50 is the creator’s spoken amount, not an independently verified transaction price.
The €/kg calculation assumes the quoted amount refers to the displayed 250 g pack. It must remain conditional in prose, visual and caption.
No verified competing price, store, purchase date, cultivar, exact piece count, peeled weight or citywide market inference.
